metadata.description: Creates each missing field by SharePoint REST createfieldasxml. Uses per-row siteUrl and listGuid.
Sequential on purpose: concurrent SharePoint field creation against the same list can collide.

runError.message: @concat(string(outputs('Compose_Summary')?['failed']), ' of ', string(outputs('Compose_Summary')?['totalRows']), ' columns failed to create. See varResults / the notification email for details.')

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @concat(if(equals(triggerBody()?['DryRun'], true), '[DRY RUN] ', if(greater(outputs('Compose_Summary')?['failed'], 0), '[ACTION REQUIRED] ', '[OK] ')), 'NITDA SharePoint column gap closure - ', string(outputs('Compose_Summary')?['created']), ' created, ', string(outputs('Compose_Summary')?['skippedAlreadyExists']), ' already present, ', string(outputs('Compose_Summary')?['failed']), ' failed')

Compose_Results_Rows_Html.inputs: @join(select(variables('varResults'), concat('','', string(item()?['num']), '','', item()?['site'], '','', item()?['list'], '','', item()?['field'], '','', item()?['status'], '','', item()?['detail'], '','')), '')
